speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. I understand you're experiencing persistent bleeding after your wisdom tooth extraction and have a history of easy bruising. To help me understand what might be going on, can you tell me if you have a family history of bleeding disorders or if you notice prolonged bleeding from minor cuts?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. The bleeding from the surrounding gums was minimally responsive to multiple gauze packs. The patient also has a history of easy bruising. Family history includes the patient's uncle who had similar issues with bleeding and a history of easy bruising and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. The history of joint swelling in your uncle is particularly significant, as it strongly suggests a possible deficiency in clotting factors like Hemophilia. Do you personally have a history of joint pain or swelling after minor injuries, or have you ever experienced prolonged bleeding after other surgeries or vaccinations?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Persistent bleeding from gums following tooth extraction. I also have History of easy bruising, Family history of similar bleeding problems and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the family history of joint swelling and the pattern of bleeding, I need to rule out Hemophilia A or B. REQUEST TEST: PT, PTT, Factor VIII, Factor IX
